title: model-catalog: add capability & pricing fields + filtered listing API
author: Ravi Narang
description: Motivation: product and SDK consumers need richer model metadata for routing, cost estimation, and OpenAI-compatibility checks. This PR introduces a new /v1/models/capabilities endpoint and enriches the existing catalog entries with capability flags, pricing/limits fields, and per-model compatibility hints for streaming, function-calling, and structured output. The change is backward-compatible for the basic /v1/models listing but adds optional query filters (capability, min_context, supports_streaming=true/false, openai_compat_level) so clients can request narrowly scoped sets. Implementation summary: 1) API: added new endpoint GET /v1/models/capabilities with query params: capability, supports_streaming, min_context, openai_compat_level, pricing_tier. The standard /v1/models now returns an optional capabilities object when ?expand=capabilities is passed. 2) Server: extended model registry schema with flat capability flags (streaming, tool_calling, structured_output), numeric fields (max_sequence, recommended_batch_size), and pricing metadata (tokens_per_dollar_estimate, request_units). 3) OpenAI compatibility: added compatibility enum {none, partial, full} and compatibility_advice string per model to guide SDK fallbacks. 4) SDK/docs: updated TypeScript/Python SDKs and docs snippets to use filters and show example responses. 5) Tests: unit tests for registry->API mapping, integration tests verifying filters and compatibility behavior, and a small canary rollout plan. Backwards compatibility: existing clients calling /v1/models without expand continue to see the existing minimal fields. Migration notes: the internal model registry migration adds the new columns with default values; ops can opt-in to recompute pricing estimates later. See linked Linear for rollout plan and QA checklist. Checklist: - [x] Spec and OpenAPI update - [x] Server implementation + migration - [x] SDK updates (TS/Py) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs and examples - [x] Canary rollout (10% traffic) - [x] Post-merge migration job scheduled Related: ENG-2742, PM-119, DES-58. Example usage: GET /v1/models/capabilities?capability=tool_calling&supports_streaming=true&min_context=4096 returns a filtered list of models that support tool calling and streaming and have >= 4096 context. Small example response snippet included in docs for SDK consumption. This PR touches API surface, runtime flags, and developer docs; reviewers should focus on schema stability and SDK ergonomics.

release_notes: Added a capabilities-aware model catalog API and per-model compatibility flags. New filters allow clients to select models by streaming support, tool/function calling support, structured output, minimum context window, and advisory pricing metadata. SDKs updated to expose filters and expanded model metadata. Backwards-compatible; expand=capabilities to opt-in.
